correctness.rationale: The proof identifies the projective span map as a proper birational smooth-source resolution, with the unique positive-dimensional fibers P^(n-k) along the smooth doubled-plane Grassmannian. Direct dimension subtraction gives codim(Z)=n+binom(k,2), hence exactly n <= 2k+binom(k,2) for semismallness and strict for smallness. A small resolution realizes IH(Q) as H(Y). At equality only the open and doubled strata are relevant; the exceptional P^(n-k)-bundle has a constant rank-one fundamental-class local system, so the projective semismall decomposition contributes a single H(G)[-2(n-k)] summand, with the expected Hodge Tate twist. Grassmannian Schubert cells and the projective bundle formula produce both exact Gaussian-polynomial formulas. The explicit code uses integer arithmetic to verify numerous instances and the n=5 conic boundary, without treating finite samples as proof.

value.rationale: The quadric-cycle locus is a canonical geometric stratum of a natural moduli space. The theorem gives a sharp structural small/semismall/non-semismall transition in all cycle and ambient dimensions, plus the complete rational intersection Betti numbers and boundary correction in the first two regimes. The boundary contribution is a genuine Grassmannian term that ordinary cohomology of the entire Chow variety does not identify. The target invariant is intrinsic and motivated, and the result is a uniform classification rather than a small isolated calculation.
